definition.simple: The fixed price at which an option lets its holder buy (call) or sell (put) the underlying.
definition.balanced: Options on the same underlying and expiry are listed at several strikes, and each is a separate contract with its own premium. Where the strike sits against the current price decides whether an option is [[in-the-money|in]], [[at-the-money|at]] or [[out-of-the-money|out of]] the money.
